rules: Always use the exact order total from lookup_order for any refund; never infer or fabricate an amount from the customer's message.
If a customer demands a refund amount that differs from the order total, escalate to a human instead of processing the refund.
Never promise or guarantee a payment timing; if a customer demands a delivery date or guarantee, escalate to a human immediately.
